verified_behaviors: Optional cancel_running defaults false and preserves historical request hashes. True durably enters Draining, cancels queued work and requests dispatched cancellation atomically with writer authority lowering and events/outbox.

Draining rejects new writer acquisition, renewal, execution dispatch and file modification. Pending cancellation retains only the original bounded identity check; it cannot grant dispatch or resolve Unknown.
Artifact worker promotes to capture only with existing durable drain proofs and current publication authority. App declarations, other active connections, active humans and Unknown remain blocking.

Real gVisor execution writes started.txt before cancellation, refuses capture before drain, accepts cancellation with a live process/IO seal, then saves and restores the file into a new Candidate. Independent SQL, signed S3 GETs and a readonly JuiceFS client verify the stop receipt, two object references, one restored file, distinct inode and absence of late.txt.
Existing preparation, Artifact daemon, execution, output download, CSI and checkpoint restoration regressions pass.
experiment_notes: No repo-sandbox targets were registered and WSL is unsupported; used the previously authorized disposable QEMU fallback with 4 vCPU, 6 GiB RAM and a 24 GiB overlay.

The initial full suites exposed a migration-22 fixture comparison including the new defaulted column. The comparison now excludes both additive columns while preserving all original historical fields; the new migration-27 fixture separately asserts cancel_running=false and successful legacy retry.
The cancellation fixture now waits for full started marker bytes. Its Volume explicitly reserves capacity for two retained checkpoint generations without changing platform limits.
The supervisor OCI image was reused after verifying its unchanged source-bound binary hash.
A fixture capacity comment was corrected to describe both new generations while the VM ran. Rebuilding produced a byte-identical execution fixture; the source manifest includes the corrected comment.
limits: One Linux VM with isolated HTTP object transport; no production TLS, HA, cross-node, load, throughput or power-loss certification.

CancelRequested is not a stop proof. Controller loss, revoked original execution identity, expired budgets or Unknown block checkpoint capture. A new publisher credential does not recreate a live execution seal.
No declared Apps and no blocking active use are permitted. This increment does not implement force stop, App/browser profile capture, arbitrary process fencing or storage GC.
Computer ready=false; public execution unsupported. Full lifecycle scheduling, runtime/App health, browser/ComputerView and T01-T43 product acceptance remain incomplete.
